debug.description: Enable verbose debug output (-d). Repeat with multiple -d for increased verbosity.

sandbox.description: Enable seccomp-bpf sandbox if compiled in (-y).

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for daemon mode (-o pid_file=...).

user.description: User to drop privileges to (-o user=...).

group.description: Group to drop privileges to (-o group=...).

only_read_files.description: Do not attempt to drop privileges (implies -N) when only reading offline files.

start_time.description: Start capture at specific time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) (-B ...).

stop_time.description: Stop capture at specific time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) (-E ...).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to capture on (-i iface...). Use ['any'] for all interfaces where supported.

vlan_filter.description: Capture only 802.1Q packets for specific VLANs (-l ...).

vlan_inclusive.description: Capture 802.1Q packets for specified VLANs AND non-tagged packets (-L ...).

input_file.description: Read from offline pcap file instead of live capture (-r ...). Use '-' for stdin.

no_promisc.description: Do not put interface in promiscuous mode (-p).

monitor_mode.description: Enable monitor mode for wireless interfaces (-M).

pcap_buffer_size.description: pcap buffer size in bytes (-o pcap_buffer_size=...).

use_layers.description: Enable pcap-thread layers parsing (-o use_layers=yes). Required for defrag/reassemble.

diagnostic_output.description: Print diagnostic DNS output to stderr (-g).

dump_format.description: Output dump format. Supported: pcap, cbor, cds, diagnostic, tcpdns.

dump_base.description: Base filename for rotating PCAP files (-w ...). Use '-' for stdout.

dump_suffix.description: Suffix to append to dump filenames, e.g., '.pcap' or '.pcap.gz' (-W ...).

time_interval.description: Time interval (seconds) for rotating dump files (-t ...).

packet_limit.description: Packet count limit for rotating dump files (-c ...).

byte_limit.description: Byte count limit for rotating dump files (-C ...).

post_rotate_cmd.description: Command to run after each dump file is closed (-k ...).

bpf_hosts_all.description: Apply host filters to ICMP/fragments as well (-o bpf_hosts_apply_all=yes).

suppress_ipv6_filter.description: Suppress IPv6-specific filter patterns (-6). Deprecated; retained for compatibility.

capture_fragments.description: Capture IP fragments (-f). Required for IP reassembly.

defrag_ipv4.description: Enable IPv4 defragmentation (-o defrag_ipv4=yes). Requires use_layers.

defrag_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 defragmentation (-o defrag_ipv6=yes). Requires use_layers.

max_ipv4_frags.description: Max IPv4 fragmented packets tracked (-o max_ipv4_fragments=...).

max_ipv4_frags_per_pkt.description: Max IPv4 fragments per packet (-o max_ipv4_fragments_per_packet=...).

max_ipv6_frags.description: Max IPv6 fragmented packets tracked (-o max_ipv6_fragments=...).

max_ipv6_frags_per_pkt.description: Max IPv6 fragments per packet (-o max_ipv6_fragments_per_packet=...).

parse_ongoing_tcp.description: Enable tracking of ongoing TCP sessions (-o parse_ongoing_tcp=yes).

allow_reset_tcpstate.description: Allow TCP state reset for recovery (-o allow_reset_tcpstate=yes).

tcp_fault_reset.description: Fault threshold for TCP reassembly reset (-o reassemble_tcp_faultreset=...).

reassemble_tcp_bfb.description: Enable extra BFB DNS parsing layer (-o reassemble_tcp_bfbparsedns=yes).

dns_port.description: UDP port to treat as DNS traffic (-u ...).

msg_types.description: Select DNS message types: q (query), u (update), n (notify). E.g., 'qn' for query and notify (-m ...).

response_errors.description: Select response errors: y=error, n=no error, t=trunc, f=format, s=fail, x=NXDOMAIN, i=NXIMP, r=REFUSED (-e ...).

hide_party.description: Hide initiator (i) and/or responder (r) IPs in output (-h ...).

drop_responders.description: Drop responses for specific responders (-Y host...).

qname_patterns.description: Include messages where QNAME or RR matches pattern (-x pat...).

qtype_include.description: Include only messages with specified QTYPE (-q ...).

plugins.description: List of plugins to load. Each object has 'plugin_path' and optionally 'options'. See bundled plugins list in manpage (e.g., anonmask.so, eventlog.so).

cbor_chunk_size.description: CBOR chunk size in bytes for 'cbor' format (-o cbor_chunk_size=...).

cds_cbor_size.description: CBOR buffer size for 'cds' format (-o cds_cbor_size=...).

cds_msg_size.description: Per-message buffer size for 'cds' format (-o cds_message_size=...).

cds_max_rlabels.description: Reverse label index size for 'cds' (-o cds_max_rlabels=...).

cds_min_rlabel_size.description: Min label size for 'cds' reverse index (-o cds_min_rlabel_size=...).

cds_use_rdata_index.description: Enable resource data index for 'cds' (-o cds_use_rdata_index=yes).

cds_rdata_index_min_size.description: Min RDATA size for 'cds' index (-o cds_rdata_index_min_size=...).

cds_use_rdata_rindex.description: Enable resource data reverse index for 'cds' (-o cds_use_rdata_rindex=yes).

cds_rdata_rindex_size.description: RDATA reverse index size for 'cds' (-o cds_rdata_rindex_size=...).

cds_rdata_rindex_min_size.description: Min RDATA size for 'cds' reverse index (-o cds_rdata_rindex_min_size=...).
